svg.title: Event Understanding — Ode to Joy
svg.desc: At the science museum, what is the final result of Andy and Wei Wei's competition on the "Sharp Eyes, Quick Hands" game? A. Wei Wei wins B. The machine malfunctions and the competition is interrupted C. They do not finish because they disagree about the rules D. Andy wins by a narrow margin E. They tie F. Andy gives up partway through G. The result is not shown Answer: A.
